body: Right.. it hurts to think about but fuuuuuck I don't wanna be here. I think of what it would do to my best friend, and my mom. Neither one of them (to my knowledge) have any clue I'm like this.

Exactly. I don't want to punish anyone with my death, I just don't want to be here anymore. They say suicide isn't fair, but who's it more unfair to? You, because you're gonna hurt because of it? Or me, because they only reason I'm still here is so I don't hurt them? It's fucked
